gloss: source (of a signal, information, or transmission)

definitions.gloss: source (of a signal, information, or transmission)
definitions.explanation: The origin or starting point of a signal, message, broadcast, trend, or piece of information. Used both for technical transmissions and figuratively for the origin of ideas, trends, or rumors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発信源|はっしんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}した→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧。
examples.english: We identified the source of the signal.

examples.japanese: うわさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発信源|はっしんげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧だろう。
examples.english: I wonder who is the source of the rumor.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発信源|はっしんげん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That city is known as a source of new fashion trends.

notes:
{発信源|はっしんげん} combines ⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧ (transmission/broadcasting) and {源|げん} (source/origin).
